svg.text: Valley map. DRAFT revision 3, 2026-09-29, Sable. Build source for Rook; G items wait for Grant.
1.8 px per m. Origin south-west, x east, z north, heights absolute. Rules and numbers: Docs/Design/Valley.md. Everything not drawn here is as Main3.md revision 16.
The map sits in a ring of ridges. The west ridge and its two hooks hide the fire from every place but the Ward ledge. The tower sees the Ward knob, never what is on it.
FIRE: far front 300 to 500 m further west (z -250 to 750), flames to 130
burning valley below the face: floor -40, fires x -50 to -150, z 0 to 500, flames to 60
day 1 and night 1: east wind lays the smoke flat, streaming west, hard top (Valley.md 3.2)
gray build: flat floor -40 from x -40 to a gray far ridge, crest 30, x -300 to -500; no colliders
terrain grows 40 m west to x -40 (G); the walkable map does not
WEST FACE: cliff from the crest to the valley at -40
ridge foot x 80

Paper, plus-3 m rule. Removed: the Wall, the pass, the plateau, the lip, the cliff-edge giant band. Stays: J, the cairn gate, every place and trail. Camp to the Ward 583 m, 233 s. Day-1 sun: bearing 200, elevation 32.

The tower sees the knob's bare top, never past it. The west saddle (95) is not on this cut: the tower line through it to the flame tops still hits the crest with 8.8 m to spare at the plus-3 rule.
